title: Health and readiness (coverage matrix, compose ratchet, live fault proxy)
proves: Every service in the production compose files has a sane healthcheck or a documented exemption, an owner, a runbook and an existing alert (or a named gap); on a local API behind TCP fault proxies /health stays 200 and /ready goes 503 within the 2 s deadline with a fixed-word, secret-free body when Postgres or Redis is refused or black-holed, and recovers; the worker probe fails when Redis is unreachable; the web /api/ready reflects API reachability.
doesNotProve: Anything on staging or production, Traefik, real container health transitions, the object store, backup freshness alerts (no metric), or that the Prometheus alerts fire (covered by the alerting runner).
